method: One family at a time. Runtime removals cut one field/clause, leaving peer predicates enabled. Required cuts remove only the tested field; closure cuts permit only the tested unknown field. Exact duplicates are proved site by site by the independent duplicate-sites driver, then jointly. Every authored negative has an accepting removal witness and restoration refusal. Other negatives retain their unchanged first-refusal prefix or complete schema-error tree; all affected schema candidates are rerun. No product validator is stubbed.
